name: Hitesh Goyal
title: Applied AI Engineer | Speech Recognition · Vision · Language Models
summary: I've spent 3+ years building speech, vision, and language models, from research at Samsung R&D and NUS to production work at Tata Elxsi and Amplify Dental.

about.bio: I start every machine-learning problem with the data: what it really represents, where it falls short, and what the problem needs. Then I build the simplest thing that could work, measure it on the metric that matters, and change course when the numbers say so.
highlights: I've used this approach across speech recognition, computer vision, biomarker discovery, and search that combines images and text. Depending on the problem, I've used classical methods, deep learning, or generative models—and changed tools when the evidence called for it.

I carry that thinking from data preparation and experiments through evaluation, deployment, and the interface people use. I build around practical limits such as response time, available computing power, data quality, and measurable performance.
focus: Speech recognition and audio machine learning
